title: Pre-registered equal-bytes comparison of HST-v1 vs Byte-BPE on WikiText-103 raw
host_intent: LapBeast RTX 4080 Laptop (CUDA sm_89, 12282 MiB), AC-powered
explicit_non_claims: This protocol does not claim that HST-v1 will win. The outcome is unknown until the official seeds finish.
This is not the 48,000-byte synthetic T-49 toy campaign and must not be reported as a foundation-model or 125M-1.3B result.
No regulated-domain readiness claim is being tested.
T-37 -0.0337 BPB is out of scope and is not re-run here.
hypothesis_to_test: At a strict equal UTF-8 training-byte budget on WikiText-103 raw, a causal LM trained with an HST-v1 tokenizer will achieve a lower held-out test bits-per-byte than the same LM architecture and optimizer trained with a Byte-BPE tokenizer of the same vocabulary size. The only intended factor is the tokenizer.
not_an_arm: Dense SP is the shared parametrization for both arms, not a third tokenizer. A rank-constrained bottleneck is not trained (it is not a fair tokenizer control and would consume wall time).

corpus.name: WikiText-103 raw v1
corpus.join_rule: For each split, concatenate the parquet 'text' column in row order as UTF-8, appending a newline only when the row does not already end in U+000A.

tokenizer_training.source: prefix of wiki.train.raw: take the first 8388608 bytes, then truncate back to the last 0x0A at or before that offset so the slice is valid UTF-8

model.note: Exact parameter count is recorded at launch. Target band is 20-50M.

optimization.lr_schedule: linear warmup, then cosine to 0.1 * lr
optimization.seed_controls: Python, NumPy, and Torch RNGs set from the official seed; CUDA deterministic algorithms not required

equal_bytes_protocol.unit: UTF-8 bytes of wiki.train.raw are charged when a newline-terminated chunk is encoded into the training buffer, in file order. The final chunk is truncated so charged bytes never exceed locked_train_bytes_per_arm_seed. Tokens sitting in the buffer after the budget is met are not trained.
equal_bytes_protocol.lock_rule: After a discarded probe (seed 0, not an official seed) of at least 60 seconds on each arm, let bps be the min raw-bytes-per-second. locked_bytes = min(target, floor((wall_budget_hours*3600*bps*safety_factor)/n_official_runs/quantize_bytes)*quantize_bytes). If locked_bytes < min_train_bytes, abort and do not start official seeds. Write budget_lock.json before seed 13 starts. Do not change locked_bytes after the first official step.

seeds.order: For each official seed, run byte_bpe then hst_v1 (so a mid-run stop still yields complete seed pairs when possible). Seeds run in the listed order.

metric.name: exact_target_byte_bpb
metric.definition: total next-token NLL in nats / (ln(2) * sum of UTF-8 byte lengths of the target tokens actually scored). Remainder tokens that do not fill a seq_len window are not scored and are not in the denominator.
metric.validation_split: wiki.validation.raw, used for logging and the first-eval sanity point only
metric.test_split: wiki.test.raw, scored once at the end of each official arm

statistical_test.method: sheaf_verify.stats.paired_t on the 5 official test BPB pairs, then sheaf_verify.stats.one_sided_less (HST BPB < Byte-BPE BPB)
statistical_test.alternative: HST test BPB is less than Byte-BPE test BPB
statistical_test.if_an_arm_fails: Do not impute. If fewer than 5 complete pairs finish, report the completed pairs and do not claim the pre-registered 5-seed test was executed.

stopping_rules: Fixed locked byte budget; no early stopping on validation or test.
Stop an arm and mark it failed (not a win) on non-finite loss or grad norm.
Thermal: pause training at GPU 83 C, resume at or below 80 C, stop the process at 85 C (checkpoint first).
AC required. Pause if mains is offline. Stop if mains is offline and battery is below 20%. Refuse to start official training if mains is offline.
Hard wall: if the 10-hour wall is reached, checkpoint, stop after the current optimizer step, and report incomplete seeds honestly.
Do not start official seeds until this preregistration is registered in the campaign sheaf store and committed.

artifacts.results_json: written under work_dir after official runs; registered through training gates later, not claimed here
